source.text: doxologia.ro, 28 octombrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Terentie cu cei 7 fii ai săi»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Τερέντιος και Νεονίλλη οι σύζυγοι και τα παιδιά τους Σάρβηλος, Νίτας, Ιέραξ, Θεόδουλος, Φώτιος, Βήλη και Ευνίκη»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the entry enumerates the same household the corpus already keeps as nine folders: the two spouses and the seven children, each with his own heading on the page. saint.gr gives the company no year, so no `dates` object is proposed. It prints one apolytikion, Ἦχος γ’ Θείας πίστεως, which names Terence, Neonilla and «ἡ τῶν Παίδων ὑμῶν ἑπτὰς ἔνθεος» and no other saint, and that is taken into all nine folders; it also prints a Κάθισμα, which is neither a troparion nor a kontakion and is not drafted. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Terentie, al Sfintei Neonila și al celor împreună cu dânșii, Glasul 4

english.text: Your martyrs, O Lord, in their contests received from you, our God, the crowns of incorruption; for possessing your strength they overthrew their torturers and broke the feeble daring of the demons. By their prayers save our souls, O Christ God.

hymns.text: Νόμω φύσεως, συνδεδεμένοι, κράτος πίστεως, ἐνδεδυμένοι, μαρτυρίου τὴν ὁδὸν διηνύσατε, σὺν Νεονίλλη θεόφρον Τερέντιε, καὶ ἡ τῶν Παίδων ὑμῶν ἑπτὰς ἔνθεος. Καὶ νῦν ἄφεσιν, αἰτήσασθε παμμακάριστοι, τοὶς μέλπουσιν ὑμῶν τὴν θείαν ἄθλησιν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιοι Τερέντιος και Νεονίλλη οι σύζυγοι και τα παιδιά τους Σάρβηλος, Νίτας, Ιέραξ, Θεόδουλος, Φώτιος, Βήλη και Ευνίκη». It names Terence and Neonilla and their godly seven children, and no other saint.

english.text: Bound together by the law of nature, and clothed with the strength of faith, you finished the road of martyrdom, Terence of godly mind, with Neonilla and the godly seven of your children. And now, all-blessed ones, ask forgiveness for those who sing of your divine contest.
